content:
**Dark theme controls take their colours from the theme (#1311)**

Under Dark, buttons rendered rgb(0,0,0) on navy (~1.3:1) and links kept UA #0000EE: buttons set a token background but never a color, no rule coloured <a>, and color-scheme was normal so UA defaults won. Fix (app.css): color-scheme light/dark per theme block, and a lowest-specificity element rule giving button/select/input color/background/border from tokens and a {color: var(--accent)}. tokens.test.mjs computes WCAG contrast from token values (>=4.5 both themes) and scans the element rules. Gotcha: a regex for 'color:' also matches 'border-color:' — use a lookbehind.
